purpose: Engineering acceptance map for functional equivalence; this file does not activate features or certify provider coverage.

constraints.theme: Preserve the current deployed SignalForge theme.
constraints.identity: Keep SignalForge branding and independent implementation.
constraints.evidence: Separate visible screenshot controls, official product claims, and verified SignalForge behavior.
constraints.providers: Hosted integrations need authorized server-side provider access; a connector in this chat is not a hosted integration.
constraints.unknowns: Waldo private workflow configuration, execution results, billing behavior, and team permissions have not been exercised live. This is not an exhaustive parity certification.

features.current: Editable owner-scoped brand/topic profiles with revision-checked saves, safe website links, search and a saved brand workspace. The workspace counts all explicitly associated reports, projects, active/archived files, saved workflows and conversations, and previews latest 10 reports/projects/active files. It opens the full brand-filtered report library, files and workflows, starts a brand-prefilled chat or research brief, and exposes the automatic weekly India rule/history. Edits atomically refresh an existing automatic rule while preserving pause/schedule/history. Existing research and chat/workflow/pitch snapshots remain unchanged; new chats capture the current website and revision.
features.gap: One global persistent selected-brand filter across every independent workspace view, team collaboration and brand revision-history restoration remain pending. Existing workflow templates and manual monitors retain captured inputs until explicitly changed.
acceptance: Switching brands scopes all related content consistently.
Reloading preserves the selection and unauthorized users cannot read another owner's records.

features.current: Brand/project-scoped independent chat with immutable brand and hypothetical persona snapshots, per-answer Strategy/Research agent choice, supported context files, cited background answers and bounded recent-turn memory. Saved conversations support search, favorites, older-chat pagination, rename/delete confirmation, retry/cancel, older-message pagination beyond 100 turns, source-aware copying and full Markdown export. Creation and send retries preserve request identity.
features.gap: Shared team My/All visibility, voice input and specialist social/ad datasets remain incomplete. Persona perspectives are simulated hypotheses, not representative research.
acceptance: Create, reopen and search a brand-scoped conversation with saved context.
My/All views respect membership and visibility permissions, including paginated older conversations.

features.current: Nine catalog cards with filters/favorites, five runnable open-web presets and four explicitly unavailable provider-dependent presets. Editable templates retain owned brand/project/file defaults, briefs, audience, competitors and time windows; support customization, duplication and step reordering. Runs snapshot inputs/steps, preserve report attempts, hand prior findings/sources forward, export combined output and rerun the saved configuration. Review mode or continuous progression with signed-webhook background execution, including when the page is closed; errors and partial results pause. Idempotent creation and expected-step/report guards protect against delayed duplicate launches.
features.gap: Specialist social/ad workflows require authorized provider connections. Richer reference workflow behavior has not been independently exercised.
acceptance: A workflow accepts saved inputs, executes defined steps, persists progress and exposes retryable failures.
Users can create, save, reopen, search and favorite workflows; a template button alone does not satisfy execution.

features.current: Owner-scoped project create/edit/search/remove, optional brand association, linked reports and workflow runs. Removing a project retains reports and run history. Project/brand-associated context files are organized through the Files library; deleting a project detaches files without deleting them.
features.gap: Team visibility/owners and scheduled project filters remain incomplete.
acceptance: Create and reopen a project containing linked research and files.
Search and reference filters return matching records; visibility is enforced server-side.

features.current: Organized Files library: PDF text (up to 50 pages), DOCX main-body text, UTF-8 TXT/CSV/Markdown. Files up to 5 MB and 100,000 extracted characters; previews, original downloads, project/brand association, rename, archive/restore. Up to three files share a 30,000-character context budget with explicit omissions and page/paragraph/line attribution. Owner checks and legacy text uploads are preserved.
features.gap: PPTX, XLSX, image/chart interpretation and scanned-document OCR. DOCX headers, footnotes, comments and visual layout are not extracted.
acceptance: Each supported format is parsed with traceable file/page references; unsupported or unreadable inputs show explicit errors.
Project/brand file selection preserves ownership and existing text uploads.

features.current: Saved sourced reports with full-account server-side title/subject/question search and combined favorites, exact labels, project/brand/type/status/date filters. Metadata-only keyset pagination reaches reports beyond the latest-100 workspace preview, including stable tied timestamps. Grid/list views share the same query, with filter/view state retained in the URL across opening reports and reloading. Full account report/completed counts are distinct from bounded overview previews. Existing organization, Markdown export, printing and revocable links are preserved.
features.gap: Requester/team filters and author collaboration remain incomplete. The legacy read-only developer report-list API still returns its existing latest-100 array.
acceptance: Favorites and labels persist; combined filters produce correct accessible results.
Grid/list views open the same report and preserve filter state.

features.current: Background OpenAI web research, citation extraction, saved reports and follow-up web research. Signed OpenAI webhooks persist terminal states without opening detail pages and advance eligible background workflows, with durable receipts and duplicate guards.
features.gap: Specialist provider/agent routing and broader private reference behavior remain unverified.
acceptance: A run reaches a persisted terminal state visible in the library without opening its detail.
Findings distinguish source facts, inference and limitations; failed runs remain actionable.

features.current: Public web research only; no dedicated social dataset or sentiment measurement pipeline.
features.gap: Authorized social search, posts/comments, timestamps, coverage and auditable sentiment analysis.
dependencies: Social data provider access and applicable usage rights.
acceptance: Results include actual retrievable posts, platform and observation dates with coverage limits.
Sentiment metrics disclose the source sample, denominator, method and uncertainty; unsupported coverage returns an explicit unavailable state.

features.current: No connected ad-library provider or creative search.
features.gap: Searchable competitor ads, creative evidence, advertiser and platform filtering.
dependencies: Authorized ad-library or licensed provider access.
acceptance: Search returns verifiable ad identifiers, creatives, advertisers, source links and observation dates.
Ad volume is not labeled as spend, conversions or performance; unavailable metrics remain unavailable.

features.current: Audience and trends templates synthesize open-web evidence. Persona snapshots offer explicitly labeled hypothetical perspectives.
features.gap: Measured trend signals and licensed representative audience panels.
dependencies: Trend data access; separate audience dataset license if representative measurement is offered.
acceptance: Trend claims include observed period, geography and the actual underlying metric.
Panel outputs expose methodology and source; simulated persona responses are clearly separated from measured audience evidence.

features.current: Dedicated Pitch workspace saves structured RFP/client intake and agency credential snapshots, references owned context files, creates an editable manual playbook, launches cited research through the existing one-step background workflow engine, explicitly imports completed research, retains append-only playbook/source revisions with conflict checks and restore, and exports saved Markdown. Intake records, agency profiles and pitches support private ownership; agency profiles and pitches can be archived/restored. Each research run consumes the existing report allowance.
features.gap: Team review/approval, structured stakeholder collaboration and rich presentation/DOCX exports. External ad/social/panel evidence still requires provider access. Human edits need source verification; revision restore covers playbook/source links, not historical intake or agency snapshots.
acceptance: A real brief plus agency credentials produces traceable requirements, uncertainties, distinct angles and sourced proof points.
Users can revise and retain a playbook, follow up, and export/share it without losing evidence.

features.current: Active hourly Google Cloud Scheduler in local-snow-508108-g3 calls the authenticated OIDC monitoring dispatcher. Daily/weekly/monthly rules, duplicate guards, retries and saved report history exist. A real Google-triggered QA report completed with four citations and one report after duplicate dispatch. QA rules are paused; all saved brands are configured for weekly India briefings, with no real business brands yet saved. Owner-scoped scan history paginates beyond 100 reports. New scans snapshot the earlier completed same-rule report at launch; comparable scopes receive a cited changes section within the existing provider call. Report detail compares normalized source URLs, links the earlier briefing and exports the comparison with the current report and citations. First/legacy/unfinished/changed-scope states are explicit; private baseline metadata is omitted from shared reports.
features.gap: Opt-in notification delivery, branded exports, user-timezone scheduling and specialist dataset coverage. Legacy reports are not retroactively assigned a baseline.
dependencies: Verified scheduler, monitored execution, delivery mechanism and appropriate connected datasets.
acceptance: Daily/weekly/monthly runs execute without an open browser, with retry and duplicate prevention.
Month-end and timezone behavior is defined and tested; delivered alerts point to saved reports with comparable periods and explicit data limits.
knownIssues: General saved timezone preference is not applied to rule scheduling; the deployed dispatcher uses Asia/Calcutta and cadence instants are UTC-based. Monthly month-end clamping is tested.

features.current: Read-only owner-scoped API keys and MCP list_reports, get_report, list_profiles.
features.gap: Provider-backed data discovery, raw/aggregate/analysis endpoints, metering and richer scoped access. Existing report access is not equivalent to Waldo/Adveron's data platform.
dependencies: Licensed data access, endpoint contracts, quotas and provider cost controls.
acceptance: Documented API/MCP requests return real connected data with provenance and bounded costs.
Key scopes, revocation, tenant isolation, rate limits and usage accounting are verified.

features.current: Google/email-password authentication, owner-isolated records and account/usage controls. Approved INR/USD Solo and Pro plans have Razorpay checkout, verification, webhooks, cancellation and usage code, but test/live payment configuration is deliberately disabled because keys were deferred. No team membership model.
features.gap: Multiple workspaces, invitations/roles and shared content permissions; merchant acceptance testing and activation after test/live configuration. Gmail sender OAuth remains in Testing.
dependencies: Confirmed SignalForge commercial terms, payment provider and transactional delivery.
acceptance: Invited members receive only their permitted workspace access; removing access invalidates subsequent reads and writes.
If payments are enabled, verified payment events update entitlements idempotently and cancellation/refund behavior follows the agreed terms.

deliveryOrder: Brand context, conversations, projects, workflows, files and report organization using the current theme.
Real provider-backed social, ads, trends and audience capabilities with observable failures and coverage disclosures.
Complete Pitch intake/playbooks and activate reliable monitoring with historical comparison and delivery.
Expand developer APIs, teams and commercial operations once access and terms are established.

verification.releaseScope: Editable saved brands and brand workspaces with safe recurring-context updates and preserved historical snapshots; current theme retained; full Waldo parity remains incomplete.
evidence: Real saved chat with contextual follow-up and a three-step background workflow were verified in the preceding releases.
Google Cloud Scheduler executed a real monitoring scan with cited saved output; duplicate dispatch produced one report.
Worker API tests exercise actual PDF/DOCX parsers, exact original downloads, file context in provider requests, invalid/scanned inputs, archive/restore and cross-owner isolation.

Worker integration tests verify pitch snapshots, concurrent revision conflicts, restore, owner isolation, duplicate launch suppression, real file context in requests, explicit imports and quota enforcement.

98 fixture/policy tests pass, including monitor ownership, baseline selection, scope changes, duplicate dispatch, pagination and shared-report isolation. Two real isolated provider scans completed with six and four cited sources; the second retained the first baseline and generated a comparison section.

104 fixture/policy tests pass; six added Worker integration tests cover an older report beyond 100, combined/literal filters, tied-date pagination/new inserts, input validation, favorites/owner isolation and developer-key compatibility. Isolated actual Workspace browser QA reaches all 132 fictional reports, recovers after a simulated page failure, and preserves filters/view after report navigation and reload.

110 fixture/policy tests pass. New checks cover concurrent brand CAS edits, ownership and read-only API boundaries, old/new chat context snapshots, unchanged report/workflow inputs, automatic-rule pause/schedule preservation, atomic rollback, all-report counts beyond 100, active/archived files and additive schema compatibility. Actual Workspace browser QA exercises stale-edit rejection with draft retention, reload locking, revised research prefill and brand-linked report/files/workflow/chat navigation.
limits: Provider-dependent social/ad/audience datasets are not connected.
Waldo private workflow execution and team permission behavior are not an exhaustive tested specification.
Build/test and live Files publication evidence are recorded separately in the release acceptance record.
